title: EnginePlugin
description: One plugin of the caller, of whichever engine has them (plan 13, B-27) — the engine's own routes say which one. `manifest` is `null` only when it can no longer be read at all — the directory moved, or the manifest stopped parsing.

state.description: `current`: the manifest reads the same as when approved. `changed`: it still reads, but differently — pending re-approval. `unreadable`: it can no longer be read at all.
